claim_scope: Separately labelled Codex/Luna visible-development comparison; not pooled with the canonical Claude-Code A/B and never treated as held-out evidence.
objective: Test whether checkpointed research plus demand-paged exact drafting evidence matches or beats genuinely comparable frozen upstream Mike accuracy under one fixed Codex Sol judge while using fewer provider-reported total tokens.

held_constant.split: visible Harvey LAB development tasks only

performer_run_policy.launch: All three candidate cells start without a serialized slot wait.
performer_run_policy.trace_gate: Inspect config, metrics, context rounds, tool events, checkpoints, exact-union sidecars, source receipts, and deliverable structure before any scoring.
performer_run_policy.fix_policy: If a trace exposes a defect, fix only request-independent shared behavior, issue a new preregistered generation, and rerun all candidate tasks.
performer_run_policy.score_exclusion: All landed full-rehydration CoC, tax, and indenture judge scores are diagnostic-only and excluded from architectural claims.

upstream.priority-tier historical cells: Context/cost diagnostics only; not accuracy comparators.

acceptance_gate.accuracy: Candidate aggregate passed criteria must match or exceed the verified comparable upstream aggregate; ties break task-by-task against regressions.
acceptance_gate.tokens: Candidate aggregate provider-reported total tokens must be lower than comparable upstream.
acceptance_gate.structure: Every expected deliverable exists, is non-empty, opens through the evaluator, and has a durable SHA-256 receipt.
acceptance_gate.checkpoint: Every durable-union evidence delta has one successful bounded checkpoint before research continues or drafting/re-drafting opens; no checkpoint failures.
acceptance_gate.paging: The complete exact evidence union remains host-side at the fixed path, first reads in each fresh context are visible, same-context duplicates are bounded, and mounted-union reads do not masquerade as new research.
acceptance_gate.fail_closed: Missing default provider tier, invalid structure, fingerprint drift, or incomparable comparator metadata blocks the claim.

actual_dynamic_fingerprints: Each run config must record exact system-prompt and tool-schema SHA-256 sets plus the combined run fingerprint; these depend on uploaded durable document IDs and are harvested from real context manifests rather than guessed before launch.

preflight.focused_backend_tests: 112 passed across the evidence, wiring, route, and working-set suites before the final full gate
